component.name: CactusPlot
component.summary: Beautiful 2D scientific plotting, compatible with Grace

description.p: CactusPlot is a fast, lightweight plotting application for scientists and engineers. It reads and writes Grace/xmgrace projects, understands the Grace command language and gracebat command line, and produces publication-quality figures with a modern default look.

ul.li: All Grace set and graph types: XY, error bars, bars, hi-lo, box plots, vector maps, polar, pie, Smith charts
Curve fitting, regression, FFT, histograms, interpolation, running statistics and more
About 1800 named colours, 50 palettes and 150 perceptual colormaps
Export to PDF, SVG, EPS, PNG and other formats
Undo/redo, live property editing, light and dark themes
